_comment: Per-site strategies, as data. nav (see nav.ts): where the page keeps its episode list — items, label, current — or its own next/prev buttons. fullscreenKey is the site's own keyboard shortcut, sent as a real key event through the debugger; seekApi names a page-world seek for players that break when currentTime is written. Leaving fullscreen needs no recipe: document.exitFullscreen() works everywhere.
